{
  "sop_id": "SOP-014",
  "title": "Purchase Request Processing",
  "steps": [
    {"step_id": "S1", "name": "Create ticket and assign to self", "role": "Executor", "type": "intake"},
    {"step_id": "S2", "name": "Validate item descriptions, quantities, specifications and required-by date", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S3", "name": "Check budget head and cost centre against latest budget report", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S4", "name": "Choose sourcing route and estimate value", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S5", "name": "Prepare PR note and submit", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "D1", "name": "Wait for budget confirmation", "role": "System", "type": "decision"},
    {"step_id": "A1", "name": "Incharge review", "role": "Incharge", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "A2", "name": "Lead approval", "role": "Lead", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "R1", "name": "Correct and resubmit on rejection", "role": "Executor", "type": "rework"},
    {"step_id": "R2", "name": "Escalate to Lead after 2 rejections", "role": "Executor", "type": "decision"}
  ],
  "approvals": [
    {"stage": "Incharge", "condition": "always"},
    {"stage": "Lead", "condition": "always"},
    {"stage": "HOD", "condition": "above HOD limit (₹10 lakh)"}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"dep_id": "D1", "provider": "Finance", "item": "budget confirmation", "parallel_group": "P1"}
  ],
  "rework_reasons": [
    "Wrong quantity",
    "Amount mismatch",
    "Incorrect category",
    "Required document missing"
  ],
  "first_pass_yield_target": 0.9
}
